svg.aria-label: UVM environment around the registered ALU: test, sequences, sequencer, driver, interface, DUT, monitor, scoreboard, coverage, config_db and the mutation results

path.title: opcode, num1, num2, result, carry_out, rst_n at posedge

g.text: clk: toggles every 10 ns (20 ns period)
num2 inverted and carry-in = 1 for SUB
SUB: res = a - b, carry = (a >= b)
bins: zero / low / high / max, reserved[5..7]
pairs each result with the operands sampled
ignores edges while rst_n is low
each mutant = one-line edit of alu.v
run through the full W=8 exhaustive test

svg.text: Open the interactive explorer to run scenarios through the design
